subject: Wholesale pastries for Lakeshore
body:
Hi Dana,

Congrats on opening your third café in Berkeley. We bake wholesale croissants and pastries every morning in Oakland, 15 minutes from Park Street. I read in Oaklandside that you want more local suppliers. Would a tasting box for the new team help next week?

Best,
Maria Alvarez
Brightside Bakery · 2150 Telegraph Ave, Oakland, CA 94612

Hi Priya,

Saw that Harborview is hosting the Uptown Art Walk afterparty on Nov 7. Our catering trays (savory croissants, mini quiches) are built for standing crowds of 150 or more. I also noticed you're hiring for a new events lead. Would it help if I sent a sample menu this week?

Best,
Maria

body:
